d: Are you a proven Quality Manager looking for the opportunity to make a genuine impact within an Industry-leading meat processor?
We are Oman's most respected and innovative meat processing businesses, supplying high-quality chilled and frozen meat products to major retail, foodservice, and manufacturing customers.

With significant investment already made in a purpose-built factory, ambitious growth targets, and a commitment to operational excellence, the business is entering an exciting period of transformation and development.

As Factory Quality Manager, you will take ownership of the site's quality and food safety agenda, leading a team responsible for ensuring the highest standards of product quality, legality, authenticity, and compliance across a complex multi-species operation.
This is more than a compliance role!

We are seeking an inspirational leader who can influence, challenge and engage stakeholders at all levels. You will be the recognised Quality & Food Safety expert within the management team, providing a clear and confident voice of expertise while working collaboratively with experienced operational leaders who bring strong perspectives and high expectations.

The successful candidate will have the credibility, resilience and presence to drive change, improve standards, and create a culture where food safety and quality are non-negotiable foundations of success.
q: Significant quality leadership experience within the meat processing industry. Meat industry Experince is Must
Strong multi-species experience, ideally covering combinations of beef, lamb and poultry.
Knowledge of both chilled and frozen product categories.
Proven success managing retailer-facing technical environments.
Exceptional leadership and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to lead from the front and influence without hierarchy.
Strong understanding of food safety systems, HACCP, ISO and retailer standards.
Passion for developing people, improving standards and delivering excellence.
r: Leading and developing the Quality and Hygiene teams.
Championing food safety and quality culture across the site.
Driving continuous improvement within the Quality Management System.
Raising standards of shop-floor hygiene, GMP and quality compliance.
Ensuring compliance with accreditation, customer, retailer and legislative requirements.
Supporting the business through growth, investment and operational development.
Acting as the site's technical authority during audits, customer visits and external inspections.
Influencing and coaching operational teams to achieve best-in-class standards.
Using data and root cause analysis to identify opportunities and deliver sustainable improvements.
x: Be part of a recognised industry leader.
Significant opportunity to influence the future direction of the business.
Join a highly capable senior leadership team.
Career progression opportunities as the business grows.
Lead meaningful cultural and operational improvement programmes.
Make a lasting impact in a business with genuine ambition.
If you are looking for a role where your expertise will be valued, your leadership will shape the future, and your influence will be felt across the entire operation, we'd love to hear from you.
